discoveredIssues.description: VAL-API-017 bug: The /api/v1/evaluations/:id/status endpoint returns progress=0 for completed evaluations instead of progress=100. Completed evaluation id: 8bb55603-42f1-4056-b073-6f805fcd5114 returns {status:completed, progress:0} when it should return {status:completed, progress:100}
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: The status handler should set progress to 100 when status is 'completed'. Check the GetEvaluationStatus handler in internal/handler/evaluation_handler.go and ensure progress is computed correctly based on status.

discoveredIssues.description: VAL-API-016 blocked: No evaluations transition to 'running' state because K8s integration (milestone k8s-integration) is not yet implemented. Requires evaluation-orchestrator feature.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: This is expected until k8s-integration milestone is complete. No fix needed at API level.
